messages:
liam: opened PR #5186 to refresh the hello-aurora quickstart. Goals: trim auth flow for first-run, add a tiny Dockerfile deploy example, and correct sample repo links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5186

sofia: thanks! question: are we keeping the full PKCE walkthrough anywhere? it confuses first-time readers.

liam: good point. removed PKCE from the main path, added a compact "PKCE migration" appendix with a link to the full sample. main quickstart now uses ephemeral client tokens for a fast first-run.

maya: CI linkcheck is failing on the sample path — docs point to /samples/aurora-old which was renamed in the samples repo.

ci-bot: build failed — jobs/docs/linkcheck — 1 broken link: /samples/aurora-old -> 404

liam: fixed to /samples/aurora-kit and added a short note recommending pinning the sample commit SHA in the docs to prevent future drift. pushed a tiny follow-up commit.

sofia: tiny consistency nit: the Docker snippet sets REDWOOD_API_KEY but our JS snippets reference REDWOOD_TOKEN in a few places. can we unify?

liam: switched all quickstart snippets to REDWOOD_TOKEN and added an "env var mapping" table that lists legacy names for backcompat. kept a one-line explanation about scopes and expiry for ephemeral tokens.

maya: also suggest adding a one-line Docker build arg to the sample Dockerfile to avoid accidental dev builds: `docker build --build-arg NODE_ENV=production -t hello-aurora .`

liam: added that line and a short note about why we suggest NODE_ENV=production for the sample. pushed commit, requesting reviews from @sofia and @maya.

devrel-bot: FYI — added a small note to community notes channel about the sample rename so external guides can update links.

ci-bot: linkcheck OK; docs/lint warnings: docs/quickstart-hello-aurora.md:line 63 sentence length.

sofia: editorial: replace "production-ready example" with "recommended for demo/staging" to avoid implying full production endorsement.

liam: updated wording per suggestion. also added a three-bullet PKCE->ephemeral migration checklist: server-exchange recommended pattern, refresh cadence guidance, and scope equivalence mapping. linked the appendix to the sample token-exchange file.

maya: could we add a small GH Actions step in docs CI that runs `npm ci && npm run build` on the sample when sample links change? catches regressions fast.

liam: good call — added a minimal check step that triggers for docs PRs touching sample links. pushed and requested approvals.

sofia: approved :thumbsup: thanks for the migration notes and the curl CORS snippet.

maya: approved. merging after main CI is green and planning a backport to release-2.x.

liam: merged PR #5186 (commit jkl012) into main. follow-up: will open a docs-only PR to update the samples README with preferred env var names and a short compatibility table. thanks everyone!
